verdict.rationale: PostHog publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (probe confirmed) and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0 specs. It also has API reference docs, such as the query endpoint and HTTP capture, plus a `posthog-cli api` command for calling the API from the shell. That gives a usable reference you can explore and run through external tools or the CLI, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive in-browser reference with runnable examples. missing for 10: an interactive try-it API explorer, runnable embedded code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
